purpose: Isolate deployment-policy construction after a shared first-actor/critic trajectory.
do_not_launch_until: tests/test_shared_driver.py passes on the launch interpreter
a later host freeze writes an environment-locked FROZEN_MANIFEST.json
bellman_rule: only the Polyak first actor supplies next-action targets; downstream actors never enter backups

deployment_branches.recenter: hop k>=2 is W2-proximal to stop-grad(actor_{k-1}); K actors; current implicit BAR
deployment_branches.data_anchor: one extra actor is dataset-anchored TD3+BC at coefficient T; two actors; current mcep control
deployment_branches.fixed_ref: hop k>=2 is W2-proximal to stop-grad(actor_1) from the same update; K actors
deployment_branches.data_anchor_matched: secondary compute-controlled contrast; repeat the dataset-anchored update K-1 times

primary_contrast.signed_difference: shared recenter endpoint minus shared data_anchor endpoint
primary_contrast.estimator: mean of nine fixed task means

secondary_readouts: first-actor D4RL return on every branch; shared first-actor scores must match across branches cellwise
data_anchor_matched minus data_anchor as a compute-control sensitivity, not the primary label

identity_gate.check: after every compared update, actors[0], critic, target_actor, and target_critic are bitwise identical across branches that consumed the same RNG and batch
